claims.claim: Session-aware radix works only with UnifiedRadixCache; session_id labels cache references, not conversation reconstruction.
Full attention eviction prioritizes unreferenced nodes then fewer session refs then configured policy; SWA and Mamba use two passes.
Internal Full eviction cascades to SWA and Mamba; SWA eviction cascades to Mamba; leaf eviction removes all components.
Finished request leaf registration checks session generation and ignores stale or closed sessions.
Session release removes references and tracks closed IDs; reopening creates a new generation.
